title: Floqer’s AI agents research sales prospects so teams don’t have to
slides: Floqer’s AI agents research sales prospects for you—but what’s the catch?
They automate the tedious data gathering that sales teams hate.
Yet they uncover hidden buying signals humans might miss.
Your team can focus on closing deals, not digging for info.
Try Floqer’s agents on your next prospect list today.
thread_text:
1. The hidden catch

Floqer's agents scrape data and flag buying signals automatically. That sounds like a win—until you see what they miss.

2. Data drones

Each agent researches one prospect at a time. It replaces hours of manual tabs but can't judge context or intent.

3. Signals you'd miss

They surface triggers like funding news or job posts. But you still need a human to decide if the timing is real.

4. Closing vs. digging

Free your team from info hunting. Yet if the agent's data is wrong, you're pitching to ghosts.

5. Test on one list

Run Floqer on five prospects today. If it doesn't save you editing time, skip it.

instagram.caption:
Sales teams spend hours digging through job posts and funding news just to figure out who's worth calling. Floqer's AI agents now do that research for them, one prospect at a time.

They scrape the data and flag buying signals like new hires or fresh funding. 🔍 But they can't judge intent or context.

If the data is wrong, you're pitching to ghosts. 👻 Your team still has to verify before closing.

So you get hours back from manual tab-hopping. ⏱️ But someone on your team still owns the judgment call.

Would you trust an agent's signal enough to skip your own research on a five-prospect test list? 🤔
